title: Target Client creation MCP vertical-spike boundary

surfaces.currentBehavior: Defines the target-only create_client tool boundary, canonical cross-runtime Client command bytes/fingerprint, scoped-user Supabase RPC adapter, strict applied/rejected result-shape validation and gated tool metadata.
surfaces.notes: The tool contract is gated and exercised only against fakes or isolated local Supabase; it is not registered in a deployed target MCP server and carries no service-role credential.

surfaces: scoped-user Supabase Client creation RPC adapter
securityRequirements: Account and Principal scope come from authenticated request context rather than tool-authored fields
The adapter forwards only the user access token and public publishable key
The tool validates exact Operation, Account, fingerprint and Client identity before reporting a result
syncRequirements: MCP and Swift encode byte-identical client-create-v1 envelopes and fingerprints
Applied and durable rejected results are terminal; transport failures remain retryable

migration.rule: Activate only with the target Supabase MCP composition; do not alter or import the Firebase MCP implementation before cutover.
reconciliation: App and MCP fixtures must produce the same canonical envelope bytes and SHA-256 fingerprint

acceptance: Malformed input never calls the backend; scoped requests use no privileged credential; mismatched results fail closed; local Supabase applies exact replay once

surfaces.currentBehavior: Tests canonical app/MCP Client command parity, context-owned Account/Principal scope, malformed-input refusal, strict terminal-state refusal and absence of service-role credentials.
surfaces.notes: Four target-only deterministic tests; hosted Auth, deployed MCP transport and production resources remain outside scope.

surfaces: target MCP Client creation contract tests
securityRequirements: Fixtures assert Account/Principal scope is context-derived and no service-role token is sent
syncRequirements: The canonical fixture must remain identical to the Swift fixture and trusted Postgres handler contract

migration.rule: Use synthetic target-only identities and never call Firebase or hosted target resources.
reconciliation: Every MCP result field used to report completion is checked against the exact command

acceptance: All Client creation MCP boundary and canonical parity tests pass deterministically without network access
